summary: SNGP's core numbers check out: composite fair value (135.96) is exactly the median of the four disclosed valuation methods, the SMA20/SMA50/RSI readings agree with the stated downtrend, the -17.21% 20-day decline is plausibly explained by dated, sourced macro news (Hormuz escalation, Brent crude spike) rather than a data glitch, no broker claim is present to audit, and no advice-language leaks were found. The one real issue is the 110.19 price cited in two medium-severity verify.json flags: it does not appear anywhere in the current live room text (which uses 101.72 throughout) and is numerically plausible as an earlier-session price along the same downtrend (it sits between SMA50 106.8 and SMA20 113.73) rather than a corrupt or ancient figure — so it reads as a stale, unreconciled leftover from a prior build rather than a wrong number currently on screen, and should be dated or refreshed if it still surfaces anywhere downstream.
